requirements.quote: This Utilization Plan must contain a detailed description of the supplies and/or services to be provided by each NYS Certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business (SDVOB) under the contract.
requirements.text: Provide a detailed description of supplies/services by each SDVOB.

requirements.quote: By submission of this Plan, the Bidder/Contractor commits to making good faith efforts in the utilization of SDVOB subcontractors and suppliers as required by the SDVOB goals contained in the Solicitation/Contract.
requirements.text: Commit to good faith efforts in utilizing SDVOBs.

requirements.quote: Making false representations or providing information that shows a lack of good faith as part of, or in conjunction with, the submission of a Utilization Plan is prohibited by law and may result in penalties including, but not limited to, termination of a contract for cause, loss of eligibility to submit future bids, and/or withholding of payments.
requirements.text: Avoid false representations or lack of good faith in the Utilization Plan.

requirements.quote: Firms that do not perform commercially useful functions may not be counted toward SDVOB utilization.
requirements.text: Only count SDVOBs performing commercially useful functions.

requirements.quote: If unable to meet the SDVOB goals set forth in the solicitation/contract, bidder/contractor must submit a request for waiver on the SDVOB Waiver Form.
requirements.text: Submit a waiver request if SDVOB goals cannot be met.

requirements.quote: Detailed description of work to be provided by subcontractor/supplier:
requirements.text: Provide a detailed description of subcontractor/supplier work.

requirements.quote: Dollar Value of subcontracts/supplies/services (When $ value cannot be estimated, provide the estimated % of contract work the SDVOB will perform):
requirements.text: Provide dollar value or percentage of work by SDVOB.

requirements.quote: All listed Subcontractors/Suppliers will be contacted and verified by [Agency].
requirements.text: Listed subcontractors/suppliers will be verified by the agency.
